notes: Locate phase. app.js and styles.css are single-line minified; locations use line 1 with a 1-based col found by exact text search. Root causes: (1) app.js 1:5424 injects '.slot:focus{outline:0}', which removes slot focus rings; (2) app.js 1:6073 inline order:-1 on 'few' slots; (3) styles.css 1:2389 '.field{display:flex}' overrides [hidden], so #permit-wrap is always shown (F-0025/F-0048), while the 1200 ms setTimeout in re() delays its toggle; (4) te() ignores the stored booking (F-0033/F-0051). F-0024 looks contradicted by the source: aria-current="step" is in all three step lists. No builder notes read.
